scope: Bounded static scientific successor-plan review only. No source/CLI/config edit, sampling, dataset creation, execution, tests, model queries, fitting, replay or release.

decision.conclusion: The single-seed genuine2D physics-only study is mathematically coherent and preserves the numerical-reference limits. Necessary definitions below must be bound in the plan or implementation protocol before the corresponding sampling/check/pilot freeze; they require no extra experiment or performance/accuracy gate.
decision.execution_authority: None. Extracted reference saved-data replay acceptance remains a prerequisite outside this review. A later implementation/check/pilot lease and any full10000-update release remain root decisions.

accepted_design.scales: H=1m,L=10m,U=sqrt(9.81)m/s,T=L/U; scaled domain[-.5,.5]^2 and t_max*=.25/T. Derive scales/axes from these identities rather than rounded display literals.
accepted_design.residuals: The accepted generic helper uses (x*,y*,t*) and scaled(h*,qx*,qy*) with g*=1. Its three conservative equations and cross-fluxes are appropriate; no new residual derivation or broad retest is needed.
accepted_design.model: Four width64 hidden layers,3inputs/3outputs give12931parameters. Positive softplus depth plus1e-6 scaled floor and signed h*u/h*v momenta impose neither y-invariance nor hard symmetry.
accepted_design.IC_area_weights: The five disjoint areas2/40/40/9/9m2 sum to100m2. Counts20/400/400/90/90 and8/160/160/36/36 have exactly.02/.40/.40/.09/.09 fractions, so one ordinary global IC sample MSE per component estimates the intended uniform-area objective. Do not subsequently give equal weight to five stratum means, which would over-weight the2m2 deep region. The20/8deep counts are a disclosed limitation, not a reason to invent a new quality gate.
accepted_design.wall_objective: Left/right penalize only qx*, bottom/top only qy*. Equal wall means are appropriate because all four edge lengths and time horizons are equal. No h/tangential labels or corner normal-vector averaging are needed.
accepted_design.partitions: Independent frozen RNG streams and disjoint train/validation/primary-final coordinates at SI64,scaled64 and the actual SIcast32-then-divide model-input32 representations support the declared strict partition. Gauss3/5 intentionally share320000 positive-time centres; mass/IC/BC auxiliary overlap is not independent-label holdout evidence.
accepted_design.operators: Primary fields are conserved cell means; velocities are qxbar/hbar and qybar/hbar, with the same ratio convention for the numerical reference. A tensor-product Gauss mean uses(1/4)*sum_i,j(w_i*w_j*U(xc+dx*xi_i/2,yc+dy*xi_j/2,t)); do not average point velocities or multiply a mean by area twice.
accepted_design.mass: Outward rates are-left qx,+right qx,-bottom qy,+top qy integrated over edge length. B(t)=M(t)-11.8+Iout(t); B(0)=M(0)-11.8; bias-subtracted balance is B(t)-B(0)=M(t)-M(0)+Iout(t). Volume/balance/edge-flux time integrals have m3 units. No momentum budget is claimed.
accepted_design.pilot_and_fullfit: One25-update representative CPU32/four-thread pilot plus one complete raw final-query workload is appropriate for feasibility. Physics-only validation may select the pilot checkpoint; no numerical-reference-error, mass-quality, symmetry or gradient-region screening may choose architecture/data/steps. A full fit, if released, starts from frozen fresh initial tensors and fresh Adam, not the pilot endpoint.

required_pre_freeze_definitions.gap: PDE and IC laws/counts are stated, but the wall free-coordinate/time sampling law and all actual-execution support checks are not yet explicit.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.concrete_required_definition: For each named wall, fix its SI normal coordinate exactly at-5 or+5; sample the tangential coordinate uniformly in(-5,5) and time uniformly in(0,.25), excluding corners and t0 unless a different explicitly frozen convention is adopted. Use the existing500/200per-wall counts and declared train/validation RNG streams; freeze call order/shuffle/index metadata before draws. Save wall names and normal-component selectors.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.IC_point_convention: Write the five actual rectangles explicitly. One consistent half-open convention is deep[-1,1)x[-.5,.5), left[-5,-1)x[-5,5), right[1,5]x[-5,5), middle-below[-1,1)x[-5,-.5), middle-above[-1,1)x[.5,5], with domain-endpoint handling stated. Point-edge convention has zero-area effect on the accepted reference averages, but one convention must govern all imposed IC labels.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.execution_check: Besides IC label stability and row disjointness, verify actual model-input32 coordinates still represent declared PDE interior/time support, exact wall normal support and noncorner/t>0 wall support. Derive the actual input arrays through the same Torch SIcast32/division sequence used by execution, rather than assuming scaled64.cast32 is identical. On a failed fixed-membership check preserve the failed evidence; do not draw a favorable replacement silently.

required_pre_freeze_definitions.applies_before: The single CPU32/64 precision comparison and pilot release.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.gap: The plan requires numerical criteria but does not provide the promised fixed subset/threshold/null specification. Blindly copying the planar first32 shuffledIC subset can omit the deep region.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.proposed_small_subset: Freeze saved training indices for32PDE points,32points from each wall, and100IC points with strata2/40/40/9/9. These exact proportions retain the study's global IC area weights and include deep points; select indices deterministically before any precision result. No new RNG search or reference labels.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.matched_state_and_inputs: Construct the CPU32 initial model once, copy the exact tensors to CPU64 by casting, and use the same fixed SI64 coordinates/IC targets with each declared execution transform. Keep identical component reductions/weights and explicit dtype constants. Compare all parameters in one frozen named order.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.existing_thresholds_to_adopt: Use the pre-existing planar precision thresholds: absolute objective discrepancy divided by abs(CPU64 objective)<2e-5; all-parameter gradient relativeL2<2e-4; gradient element allclose rtol2e-3,atol2e-5. Record raw/component discrepancies and denominators, not just passed=true.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.residual_and_null_completion: Because the new plan explicitly promises residual comparison, freeze its per-element dimensionless tolerance before use; a concrete compatible option is allclose rtol2e-3,atol2e-5 for each residual component. For exactly zero CPU64 objective/gradient/residual norm, report relative=null with a zero_cpu64_norm reason; a concrete fallback is absolute objective discrepancy<=2e-5 and the stated elementwise atol2e-5 for zero gradient/residual arrays. Do not add epsilon to a denominator. Freeze these choices rather than choosing them from observed differences.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.rationale: These are one fixed arithmetic/autograd sanity check, not long-trajectory equivalence or a physics-accuracy target. No precision/device sweep, extra training or result-driven threshold adjustment is requested.

required_pre_freeze_definitions.gap: The plan promises output-node replacement and an absolute wall mismatch but leaves their exact operations to implementation.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.concrete_schedule: Let t_out[k]=.005*k,k=0..50. Start the501-node schedule at .25*j/500,j=0..500 and replace indices10*k with exact frozen t_out[k]. Start the1001-node schedule at .25*j/1000 and replace indices20*k likewise. Verify/hash increasing SI64 and actual execution time arrays, endpoints0/.25 and exact output-node membership; integrate each prefix to those exact indices using trapezoidal weights from actual frozen SI node differences. No interpolation or extra nodes.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.concrete_spatial_rule: For volume use midpoint area weights100/n^2 at each of51times; for each wall use midpoint edge weights10/n. State that quadrature weights/accumulation are float64 SI geometry while queried model inputs/outputs follow the frozen CPU32 path.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.absolute_wall_quantity: Retain each signed normal-q edge array/rate and define Qabs_edge(t)=sum(length_weight*abs(q_normal)) in m3/s, with its trapezoidal cumulative integral in m3; optionally the already available maxabs normal q has m2/s units. This prevents opposite signed wall errors from disappearing inside a net rate. It requires no additional queries.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.refinement_interpretation: Spatial changes both volume and edge spatial rules; temporal changes the time rule while retaining the base volume operator. Save/report deltaM and deltaIout separately as well as deltaB. Do not label the combined spatial balance difference an isolated volume-error estimate.

required_pre_freeze_definitions.applies_before: Frozen evaluation/analysis contract; no pilot accuracy analysis is needed.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.gap: The numerical-gradient mask area varies with time, so 'area/equal-time' alone does not determine pooled regional reductions. The existing whole-domain R6 formulas coincide under constant area but some regional alternatives do not.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.concrete_option: For regionR_t, let A_t=sum_Rt A. Compute per-time MAE=sum_Rt(A*abs(d))/A_t and RMSE=sqrt(sum_Rt(A*d^2)/A_t). Use mean_t(MAE_t) and sqrt(mean_t(RMSE_t^2)) for equally weighted area-mean pooled values. For a pooled integral relativeL2 consistent with R6 use100*sqrt(sum_t,Rt(A*d^2)/sum_t,Rt(A*reference^2)); name it explicitly, since with changingA_t it is not the ratio of equally time-weighted area-normalized RMS values. Freeze the same formulas for the complement.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.nulls: Return null+reason on an empty region or zero reference norm; preserve SI errors when only relative norm is undefined. Do not silently omit times or add a denominator epsilon. The frozen current reference masks are nonempty at all50times, so no extra empty-region test campaign is requested.
required_pre_freeze_definitions.velocity_and_sensitivity: The accepted wet reference has hbar>=.1m, so all reference cells can be included for the cell-ratio velocity metrics; never drop a cell because the NN predicts low depth or a large error. Dspace/Dtime/Dsum frozen in R6 belong to h/qx/qy. Do not attach a discharge-valued indicator to a velocity error; either state those indicators are conserved-field-only or separately predeclare ratio-derived velocity differences from the same saved reference records.

exact_interface_and_cost_freeze_notes.scales_constructor: Scales requires H_m,Lc_m,Uc_m_s,Tc_s, not a literal two-argument Scales(H=1,L=10) call. Construct all four fields directly with the stated identities; avoid Scales.from_case on the incompatible new dedicated case schema.
exact_interface_and_cost_freeze_notes.autograd_interface: Call physics_2d.residuals(model.forward,coords_nd) with dimensionless coordinates/states. model.physical_state consumes SI coordinates. Do not pass physical_state as the scaled state function or nondimensionalize twice.
exact_interface_and_cost_freeze_notes.resolved_count_adjustment: Root corrected the earlier planning-only1,632,000volume/13,313,280total ambiguity before this reviewed hash. The current no-dedup plan queries all three volume passes separately, including identical base/temporal geometry. No executed dataset was affected.
exact_interface_and_cost_freeze_notes.count_scope: The9/25Gauss rules cover50positive times. The three mass volume passes cover51initial-inclusive times. No separate t0 Gauss error query is counted; t0 is IC/mass evidence. Intentional final-rule centre overlap and base/temporal query repetition remain counted.
exact_interface_and_cost_freeze_notes.step_and_IO_cost: Freeze/count step0 training-component+validation/history/setup work in addition to25actual pilot backward/Adam cycles; full proposal includes step0 plus10000cycles. Specify selected/latest optimizer-checkpoint persistence policy and query batch/order before pilot, then use that same policy for the full cost projection. Reuse data does not authorize reuse of pilot-trained weights.
exact_interface_and_cost_freeze_notes.budget_scope: State which stages the proposed1200s new-full budget includes. Add measured full-query/reload/output work once to the10000-cycle projection and include setup/terminal/persistence scope. Keep unmeasured later analysis/archive/startup or extracted-replay work explicitly separate; do not call an incomplete stage sum an inclusive bound. Mean/median/max step projections remain estimates, not runtime guarantees.

preserved_limits: One seed, synthetic idealized imposed IC/BC, physics-only collocation; no human/field/generalization evidence or trained model exists under this planning review.
Numerical-reference mesh/time sensitivity remains material, particularly discharge. NN comparison must preserve that limit rather than treating selected reference as exact truth.
No hard symmetry, artificial viscosity, Manning friction, label fitting or model-quality gate is added.
Only this named review JSON is written. Every source, prior reference result/archive, failed attempt and prior review remains unchanged. No cross-chat tool message was sent.
